messages:
Maya (AE): FYI — Orion Labs sent an RFI this morning. They want a concise capability matrix, a 2-week Dedicated POC plan + itemized pricing, compliance answers (EU residency + HSM), and perf numbers targeted at ~100k tokens/day chat. Deadline Thu EOD.
Ravi (SE): Got it. I can repurpose our standard matrix but will need Clara to confirm POC test cases and Diego to run the load run on staging.
Clara (Solutions Eng): I'll own success criteria + test prompts. Propose: conversation mix 60% short (<=64 tok), 30% medium (256 tok), 10% long (512+). Success = latency p95 <= 500ms and token error rate < 0.1%.
Noah (Security): Actions: I'll draft answers for data residency, KMS/CMK, HSM, network isolation, SSO/SCIM, and logging. Important: callout that HSM is available for Private deployments with partner HSMs — lead time 4–6 weeks.
Diego (Infra): For perf I'll run a Dedicated staging job. Use load-runner: `tools/load-runner --model rwd-v1-xl --concurrency 8 --seq-mix \"64:6,256:3,640:1\" --requests 15000`. Expect to drop CSV + brief writeup.
Maya (AE): Budget note from buyer: they indicated $30k preferred for POC but can flex. Need a line-by-line quote (reserved nodes, extra throughput hours, support, optional HSM/installation).
Ravi (SE): Matrix rows I'll populate: Hosted API, Dedicated reserved, Private (VPC/on-prem), streaming, batching, prefix/KV cache, quantization (int8/int4), rollouts/canaries, model catalog, SDKs, embeddings, function call support, and SLA (p99 gen latency / uptime).
Clara (Solutions Eng): POC plan outline (2 weeks): Week 1: setup, seeding with eval prompts, baseline perf run; Week 2: workload run, tuning (batching/quant), HSM smoke if requested, final report. Will add timeline hours per task.
Noah (Security): I'll attach SOC2 summary and AES-256 confirmation. Also flag: EU data residency is supported in eu-west-1; for Private we can deploy into customer VPC.
Diego (Infra): Uploaded: orion_dedicated_run_176753.csv and orion_latency_plots_176753.png. files-bot should have both.
files-bot: file uploaded: orion_dedicated_run_176753.csv
files-bot: file uploaded: orion_latency_plots_176753.png
Maya (AE): Perfect. Clara — can you assemble the capability matrix + POC pricing worksheet into a single zip? Then I'll add a short cover note and send to emily@orionlabs.com by Thu EOD.
Clara (Solutions Eng): Will do. Checklist I'm compiling: capability_matrix.xlsx, poc_plan.md, pricing_sheet.csv, security_responses.pdf, perf_csv + png, sample-sla.pdf.
Ravi (SE): Quick note for content: include the curl example and load-runner snippet in the tech appendix.
Maya (AE): Sync tomorrow at 09:30 to finalize. If anyone needs to update answers before then drop them here. Thanks :raised_hands:
